title: Canonical Identity, Invitation & Campaign Membership
selected_by_owner: 2026-09-25 owner direction to keep going but stop overloading the original 10 PCV tranches; PCV-03 decomposed using the established lettered-work-item pattern.
objective: Distinct Windows/Android users join through canonical local-first subject identity, recipient-bound A3 invitation semantics and A5 Campaign membership authority, with no parallel PCV-03 membership ledger.
acceptance: Bind production local profile/subject state to the canonical stable-subject session seam without making device identity or transport claims authoritative.
Implement recipient-bound, expiring, revocable, one-time/idempotent invitation acceptance through A3 semantics; raw invitation bearer material is not persisted in ordinary product documents.
Implement the local-first A5 Campaign membership adapter over durable product storage; Campaign role/state is the only membership/role authority used by PCV-03.
Support current membership states needed by PCV-03 authorization, including active/suspended/left/removed, and fail closed for unsupported role translations.
Bind accepted transport peers to the canonical subject/membership/device context so later commands/presence cannot impersonate another member.
PCV-03B+ and PCV-04 remain unauthorized until this item closes.
boundaries: Preserve PCV-01/02 completed product state and existing canonical A3/A5/P9/SMB owner contracts; implement adapters rather than parallel authorities.
Do not implement PCV-03B Session-lifecycle work except interfaces strictly required to keep PCV-03A compilable and fail-closed.
Do not implement gameplay/action/combat behavior; PCV-04 remains unauthorized.
Do not perform installed physical proof or regenerate completion packages in PCV-03A.
Keep direct/manual zero-service architecture viable; no paid/hosted identity or networking provider becomes mandatory.
Use milestone-level OPS3 state only; no activity-journal instrumentation.
next_action: PCV-03A is completed_verified. PCV-03B is selected_not_started; await a later owner Continue before Session launch/lifecycle implementation begins.
